messages.subject: Request for Wheat Shipment – Ref #WF-2026-07
messages.body:
Dear Rohan,

We would like to place a new order for 25 metric tonnes of Quality A wheat under reference WF-2026-07. The total amount will be INR 3,75,000. Kindly confirm availability and arrange dispatch by 2026-06-12. Please share the pro‑forma invoice at your earliest convenience.

Thank you,
Rahul Mehta
Agrifarm Exports
Hi Rohan, this is Maya. Please confirm a shipment of 12 pallets of plastic containers (ref: ML-2026-03). We need them by 2026-06-20. Let us know the total cost and payment terms. Thanks!

messages.subject: New Order: Cardamom – PO 1123
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Sharma,

We are ready to place a fresh order of 4,500 kg of green cardamom under PO 1123. The amount totals INR 4,95,000. Kindly arrange dispatch no later than 2026-06-25 and send the shipping documents for customs clearance.

Best regards,
Anita Kapoor
Sunrise Spices Ltd.
Rohan, please note our request for 18 cartons of aluminum foil (ref KT-2026-08). Needed by 2026-07-05. Quote the price and confirm the shipment schedule. Thanks.

messages.subject: Request for Steel Rods – Ref #SW-2026-08
messages.body:
Hello Rohan,

We require 30 tonnes of high‑grade steel rods (diameter 12 mm) under reference SW-2026-08. The total purchase value will be INR 9,60,000. Kindly schedule dispatch to our Mumbai warehouse by 2026-07-18 and forward the insurance certificate.

Regards,
Vijay Singh
BlueWave Exports

messages.subject: Bulk Order for Jute Bags – PO #EB-2026-09
messages.body:
Dear Rohan,

Please process a bulk order of 8,000 jute shopping bags (size 35 × 40 cm) under PO #EB-2026-09. The total cost is INR 2,24,000. We need the shipment to arrive at our Delhi depot by 2026-08-30. Include a copy of the eco‑certification in the shipping paperwork.

Thank you,
Neha Verma
EcoBags Co.
